set.body:
Outcome

Perform a requirement-by-requirement completion audit before closing the final gate or epic.

Acceptance

- Every child and phase gate is closed with implementation and test evidence.
- Relevant commits are proven ancestors of the audited HEAD.
- The zero-cruft court is empty and the one-module build graph is authoritative.
- Both vertical slices and all retained method families are present through one ontology.
- Any unresolved requirement keeps this ticket, Phase 7, and the epic open.
set.title: P7.7: audit every epic requirement and close only from evidence
